verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Infernal Chains range and eat the drag-back for double damage; you win if you bait Umbral Dash (E) before committing Blade Waltz or an all-in.

brief.thesis: Riposte (W) is a hard answer to Aatrox's Deathbringer Stance empowered auto, but he has a direct out: Umbral Dash (E) lets him dash away rather than walk into your parry, which is exactly why OP.GG flags 'Aatrox will use E to dodge Riposte.' Neither tool auto-wins the exchange, so the matchup is decided by whoever burns the other's dash or parry first — matching the even solo-kill rate underneath Fiora's stronger 56.3% overall win rate.

theirWindow.when: Passive glow lit and Infernal Chains ready
theirWindow.what: He'll hook W (Infernal Chains, 825 range) to close distance or punish a dash, then land the glowing empowered auto for bonus magic damage plus a heal off your max HP. Don't stand still when he starts glowing — sidestep the chain's pull zone so you don't get dragged in and hit twice.

yourWindow.when: His Umbral Dash (E) or Infernal Chains (W) is down
yourWindow.what: Without E to reposition or W to threaten a hook, Aatrox has no way to disengage or extend. Chain both Lunge (Q) casts into him and pop Burst of Speed (E) for the attack speed and move speed stacks — he cannot answer your damage output in that window.

start.why: 57.3% win rate over 227 games and the dominant 92.3% pick — the AD and sustain fuel the Q-into-Riposte trade pattern from level 1.

boots.why: 54.3% win rate over 164 games and 75.2% pick — Aatrox's Q swings and empowered autos are all physical damage, so flat armor reduction outvalues tenacity here.

Second in the same 71.4% path — the damage spike lets you win extended trades once his Umbral Dash is on cooldown.
Closes the highest win-rate path (71.4%, 49 games) — durability against his Deathbringer Stance burst if he lands it anyway.

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking AD and heal rewards the double-Lunge auto-attack trade pattern, and this page's 53.8% win rate (208-game sample) edges out the Press the Attack page; Bone Plating in Resolve blunts the burst from his back-to-back Q swings and Infernal Chains follow-up.

summoners.why: 57.5% win rate at 92.8% pick rate — Ignite cuts through the healing stacked in his passive, Umbral Dash, and World Ender, letting you finish all-ins before he stabilizes.

playing.title: Bait Umbral Dash (E) first
playing.detail: He'll dash away rather than eat a Riposte parry. Poke with Lunge (Q) until you see the dash spent before committing to Blade Waltz or a full all-in.

playing.title: Save Riposte for the glow
playing.detail: Time W specifically for his Deathbringer Stance empowered auto — parrying it removes both the bonus magic damage and the heal. Don't waste the parry on a normal auto.

playing.title: Count his Darkin Blade swings
playing.detail: Aatrox's Q hits up to three times with a different area each swing. Track which swing he's on before you commit to a trade in his effective range.

playing.title: Chain both Lunge casts
playing.detail: Q can be recast for free within a couple seconds of the first — always spend both charges in one trade window to stack Duelist healing.

playing.title: Play outside 825 range
playing.detail: Infernal Chains reaches 825 range. Stay outside it, or be ready to walk out of the impact zone immediately so you don't get dragged in and hit a second time.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 all-in
playing.detail: World Ender comes online at 6 on a 120-second cooldown and grants AD, healing, and move speed. Back off from extended trades the moment he hits that level.

playing.title: Ignite through his sustain
playing.detail: Once you commit to a kill, burn Ignite immediately — it cuts through the healing layered across his passive, Umbral Dash, and ultimate.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, rune pages, and win rates here are measured from live games on the current patch (208-game sample, 56.3% Fiora win rate); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are our own read of the kit.
